references.text: The Lord commands Moses to carry out vengeance against the Midianites, which is the direct fulfillment of the command in 25:17
The previous verse explains the reason for hostility toward the Midianites—they led Israel astray
The continuation explaining why Israel must treat the Midianites as enemies—because of their treachery at Peor
Describes how Israel struck down the Midianites and killed their kings, fulfilling the command
A similar command for perpetual war against Amalek from generation to generation
The Midianites later oppressed Israel, showing the ongoing conflict between the peoples
Gideon defeats the Midianites and kills their princes, a later fulfillment of the hostility
